research_findings.detail: Need clap-juce-extensions shim until JUCE 9 (no public release date).

research_findings.finding: SRC library pick is the single biggest engineering decision
research_findings.detail: Leaning libsamplerate Sinc-Medium (BSD-2). r8brain-free (MIT) as fallback. zita-resampler disqualified (GPL-3). Cascades into RT-safety, PDC, CPU, licensing.

research_findings.finding: Dither at float->int16 input is a DSP-character decision
research_findings.detail: Leaning no-dither per North Star (period-faithful sources arrived as int16 PCM; dither is a modern courtesy SPU never had). TPDF defensible alternative.
